assertions.assertion: A fresh normal run requires only a provider name, home market and difficulty, all with defaults.
The first view contains an objective, finite capital, a customer opportunity and a costed action. No JSON or pack-start buttons are required.
Existing training and SP saves remain separately accessible.
Campaign attempts to set supplier cost, arbitrary capacity, customer requirements, fault events, task success or quality grades fail atomically through UI, worker and MCP paths.
Retail quotation is permitted only through authored customer acceptance rules.
No public system:true or arbitrary-command escape hatch is added; Lab editing remains available on a custom copy.
Uncommissioned blueprints supply no usable entitlement, service, capacity or revenue.
Buying a supported plan creates its necessary dependencies through validated commands without asking the player to start internal packs.
Ownership and entitlement gate later capacity changes.
Pause and 0.5x/1x/2x/4x/8x are available. Prices use /period, never an unexplained /month.
Equal simulation-time commands at different speeds yield identical demand, outcomes, balances and rewards.
Decision modals, hidden tabs, lost editing ownership and terminal outcomes pause; no undisclosed offline catch-up occurs.
Stale or unaffordable quotes cannot double-spend or create partial inventory.
Repeating the same request ID does not charge, reserve or reward twice.
The client supplies offer and recipe identifiers, not authoritative wholesale cost or success.
Creating a second customer does not create opening cash.
Internal transfers do not become external revenue, and settlement receipts post once.
Cash available excludes reservations; cash, commitments, liabilities and operating profit remain distinguishable.
The unfunded 20-engineer, 1,440-minute project repro cannot start without an explicit funded or credit-backed commitment.
An unavoidable bill can enter grace/default without crashing the engine or enabling unlimited discretionary spending.
Forecast recurring exposure before commitment; do not escrow every future cost unless the scenario requires it.
Passing the four-command foundation SMB repair cannot complete a provider campaign.
A probe or manually generated test cannot mint earned customer revenue or commercial progression.
Every mission authors arrivals, deadlines, activation, service/credit/renewal rules, grace/default and a sustained victory predicate.

The proposed SMB reference requires two consecutive full periods with at least 22 of 24 due cases completed on time and positive provider operating result, no overdue critical obligations, and a funded next contract. A quiet or partial period cannot satisfy it.
Legacy guided/assessed imports remain Training and legacy sandbox imports remain Lab.
A campaign exported to Lab is custom; changing a label does not restore earned campaign status.
Validate with the known old schema before migration, preserve the original, and reject unknown versions clearly.
Calls, messages and CC arrivals appear without Generate test interaction.
Sampled particles and traces do not create or bill additional work.
Offered, admitted, pending, completed, failed and abandoned totals conserve jobs across handoff and retry.
An evenly distributed test workload with 57 minutes of outage cannot become a perfect period after a last-minute repair.
A final-minute outage cannot erase completed service from the prior 59 minutes.
Credits, usage, renewal evidence and visible bill explanations agree with the same recorded facts.
An endpoint call with a declared duration produces the expected occupancy and metered usage.

Immediate connectivity probes do not count as completed commercial conversations. Existing synchronous consumers such as siteHooks.journey migrate to explicit probes or asynchronous delivery evidence.
Waiting, talk time, connected carrier-leg occupancy and customer-billed units have explicit definitions.
Loss of both media directions during a call cannot silently yield a successful conversation.
One-way media produces its declared degraded/failed outcome.
Loss of signalling alone does not automatically destroy surviving established media; local fallback must be provisioned.
Capacity-one recording cannot capture four simultaneous recording-required sessions.
No available room/meeting capacity prevents an additional admission.
Cancellation, timeout, failure, normal completion and migration each release reservations once under a declared policy.
Two simultaneous jobs cannot allocate the same engineer or reserved money twice.
Reduced support capacity increases eligible backlog/response time; reducing staff is not an identical-outcome cost saving.
Cost coherent operations, not each field write; inspection and planning stay free.
A player can afford each reference plan individually but cannot buy every advantage without sacrificing another opportunity.
A changed supported seed/constraint changes a relevant investment or response.
The evaluator accepts outcomes and constraints, not only one exact recipe.
At 1366x768, cash, clock, objective, map and primary actions are reachable without scrolling through setup.
The default opening has no oversized hero or stacked module forms.
Match the bright map, white sticker panels, ink outlines, yellow actions and pink player selection with readable states.
Purchasing, commissioning, losing and retiring a service visibly changes the correct nodes/paths.
Drag or click-connect opens a compatible costed plan; a keyboard/menu action does the same.
Region/geography, service dependencies and flows are selectable layers; graphics never grant service capability.
A purchase card names the cost now, /period commitment, work, lead time, limits and expected outcome.
An incident card names affected customers, cause confidence, response options and each cost/delay.
Blocked actions explain prerequisites and a way forward; no silent disabled button.
An unfinished purchase draft retains values, focus, selection, scroll and expanded details during ticks.
Camera and selected customer persist across ordinary events.
Revalidate a changed quote at commit and explain any difference without silently accepting it.
The opening can be completed without drag, hover or colour-only information.
At 390x844, bottom navigation/context sheets preserve the same actions without horizontal page overflow.
Use visible focus, labelled status, restrained live announcements and at least 44px primary touch targets.
Provisioning, effective readiness and observed success are visibly distinct.
A player can open a bill or failure explanation without raw trace codes.
Optional sound and sampled animations reflect real events; both can be disabled.
The six steps cover launch, external connection, partner capability, operation, expansion and a larger contract.

Coaching can be dismissed/resumed and recognises valid states reached out of order. An accepted order may satisfy an ordering milestone; it cannot satisfy commissioned service. Highlight Resume as soon as pending delivery is needed.
First costed choice within 2 minutes and first delivered work within 5 minutes are measured design targets, not claims of current performance.
The main inspector answers what is happening, who is affected, the likely cause and useful actions.
Experts can inspect detailed interaction paths, desired/effective state and evidence without editing world facts.
Diagnosis can consume time/effort when the scenario makes it a decision; looking at public information is free.
At least one mission incident has two sensible responses with different cost, time or customer loss.
Earlier redundancy, staffing or architecture changes impact or available responses.
A Repair action creates an eligible costed job; it cannot directly declare the service recovered.
The player may quote retail prices but cannot force willingness to pay or contract acceptance.
Repeated poor service triggers bounded credits, lost demand, refusal/exit or scenario failure under visible terms.
An unavailable arbitrarily expensive offer cannot create an indefinitely repeatable profit strategy.
The first sustainable customer changes the next available decision.
Training badges/credits remain separate from earned commercial money and progress.

A bulk joiner or migration template reduces repeated effort without bypassing entitlement or delegation.

A supported customer preference change alters a quote, channel investment, capacity plan or margin.
Substitution cannot remove PSTN, emergency, identity, information-boundary or other mandatory requirements.
Voice-to-digital handoff preserves one customer case; it cannot claim two independent resolutions.
A player can reconcile the displayed bill and cash movement to named economic events.

Two plans or operating responses are viable and differ in margin, flexibility or risk.
A remembered tutorial recipe is not the only accepted solution.
Staged coexistence and a more consolidated rollout create different staffing, time and compatibility consequences.
Actual number/identity/room dependencies affect work during cutover and recovery.
Settlement and renewal reflect the delivered migration and service outcomes.
Eligibility follows actual paths and versioned evidence, not only a country field.
Two compliant architecture/operating plans differ in cost, lead time or workload.

Spares, staffing, autonomy duration and deferred synchronisation create real choices.

Supplier-owned capabilities, third-party additions and scenario fiction remain distinguishable.

A licence alone cannot create a physical room, staffed support or compatible media.
Local media resources change supported load or resilience without becoming an unrestricted substitute for a cloud service.

Handoff distinguishes playable UI revision, remaining full-conversion obligations, browser verification and publication status.
